title: What Is a Load Lock? How Wafers Are Exchanged Without Opening the Vacuum Chamber
excerpt: Exchanging wafers without opening the vacuum chamber: the role of the load lock. What you will learn in this article: If the whole vacuum process chamber were vented to atmosphere every time a wafer is exchanged, the burden of re-pumping and of surface conditions would grow.
